description: The graph of a unary function represented by a term with parameters from \(A\) is \(A\)-definable.
signature:
Set.TermDefinable₁.definable₂_graph.{u, v, w} {M : Type w} {A : Set M} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [L.Structure M]
  {f : M → M} (h : Set.TermDefinable₁ L f) : A.Definable₂ L (Function.graph f)
